key_features: Fantastic Results Without The Fatigue - With minimal effort you can perfectly shred and slice cheese and vegetables. Get creative and make dinner exciting again by grating, slicing and making fresh zest to take your meals to another level. Plus, this kitchen cheese grater is dishwasher safe.

Food Prep Done Fast With Our Sleek Design: Shred a block of cheese in no time. Freshly grated food using our food shredder can completely improve the taste and texture of what you prepare. This professional grater with handle has a sleek design that makes grating cheese and soft foods easy and can fit in most kitchen drawers.

Take Pride In Your Mastery Of The Culinary Arts: One simple kitchen tool that will completely improve the taste and texture of what you prepare. Skip the food processor which is a hassle to clean and gives subpar results.

Incredible Versatility With The 4 Sided Design Kitchen Grater: Coarse grating, Medium grating, Fine grating/Zester and even a Slicer - all in one convenient tool. Quickly prep an array of foods like cheese, parmesan, potato, squash, zucchini, carrots, lemons and cucumbers. Multi-functional manual cheese grater with a comfortable handle that gives you total control.

Kitchen Must-Have: Sharp Stainless Steel blades get the job done quickly and result in cleanly sliced and grated food. The removable rubber bottom prevents slipping and sliding on your counter, cutting board or plate. It also prevents food from escaping out the bottom of the vegetable grater so you'll have less to clean up.
